description: Excavate every cyan core from the moving ore racks before it reaches the crusher. Mine teal-seamed stone, preserve gold striped supports, and exit with all ore. EXIT is a final submission. A broken support, lost core, or rejected EXIT ends the episode. Missed picks and view changes remain allowed. Use only the visible task UI.
name: Isometric Voxel Extraction Mine V2 · Difficulty 4 · Simplified Interaction
